title: Release gating cadence and rollout notes - Oct 2026 (draft)
body:
Overview:

Purpose: capture a compact, operational-first release gating cadence and the associated checklist + rollout notes for the October 2026 runtime/edge routing change. This is the working-run doc for the release team — keep it lean.

Scope: runtime scheduler changes (v2.4.0), routing policy shuffle to prefer low-cost regional pools, and a minor config schema update for autoscaling thresholds. This impacts Hosted API and Dedicated. Private packages will be bumped but not pushed automatically.

Stakeholders:
- Release lead: Aisha Patel
- Platform eng: Marco Ruiz (deploy/infra), Liam O'Connor (metrics/tracing)
- Product owner: Jenna Cho
- SRE on-call: rotation week Oct 12-18 -> Priya (primary), Alex (backup)
- Solutions eng (customer-facing notices): Radu Ionescu

High-level cadence (gating stages):
1) Feature freeze (FF) — code & config locked for this release. No new features after FF.
   - Date: 2026-10-12 09:00 PT
2) Staging deploy + smoke validation (S1) — run the standard staging smoke suite + quick manual flows.
   - Date/time: 2026-10-13 10:00–14:00 PT
   - Goal: functional parity and basic perf sanity.
3) Staging soak (S2) — 24h soak in staging with synthetic traffic and prefix cache warmers.
   - Window: 2026-10-13 14:00 -> 2026-10-14 14:00 PT
4) Pilot-region ramp (P1) — small traffic slice (2%) routed to pilot region (us-west-2).
   - Window: 2026-10-14 16:00 -> 2026-10-14 20:00 PT
   - Metrics to watch: 99p latency, error rate, token/sec throughput, cost-per-token delta, model output sanity (sample prompts).
5) Regional rollouts (P2) — incremental ramps by region: EU -> APAC -> NA (full).
   - Schedule (best-case): 2026-10-15 -> 2026-10-16
6) Full cutover and vigilance (P3) — full traffic + 48h elevated monitoring.
   - Start: 2026-10-16 09:00 PT

Operational checklist (pre-flight and gates):
- [x] Code merged to release branch and build artifacts verified (owner: Marco)
- [x] Release notes drafted and product reviewed (owner: Jenna)
- [x] Staging infra snapshot taken (owner: platform backups)
- [ ] Smoke tests passing in staging for both text-gen and embeddings (owner: QA)
- [ ] Autoscaling thresholds for dedicated pools configured and validated (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Rollback packages created and smoke-validated (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Ops runbook updated with new routing keys and emergency switches (owner: Aisha)
- [ ] Customer-facing incident template prepared (owner: Radu)
- [ ] Alerts tuned (SLO: 99p latency < 600ms for gen models, error rate < 0.5%) (owner: Liam)

Gate evaluation rubric (pass/fail criteria):
- Functional: all critical smoke tests green; no new 5xx error classes in logs.
- Performance: 99p latency increase <= 15% vs baseline; token cost delta < 5% for typical traces.
- Reliability: averaged error rate <= 0.5% for the 1h observation window; no user-visible degradations on sample flows.
- Output quality: run the canonical prompt set (eval-set A) and verify there are no >10% regression in BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim threshold depending on workload.

Rollback triggers and quick actions (matrix):
- Trigger: sustained 5xx spike > 1% for 5 minutes -> Action: pause ramp, route traffic back to pre-release pool, page SRE.
- Trigger: 99p latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes -> Action: throttle new sessions, reduce batching aggressiveness, if not recovered -> rollback.
- Trigger: quality regressions on eval-set A > 10% -> Action: immediate stop of rollout + fallback to previous model variant.
- Trigger: sudden cost spike > 25% in pilot region -> Action: pause routing policy, enable cheaper fallback region.

Rollout calendar (detailed):
- 2026-10-12 09:00 PT — Feature freeze + branch cut (release/v2.4.0)
- 2026-10-13 10:00 PT — Deploy to staging (S1) and run smoke pipeline (smoke-run/2026-10-13)
- 2026-10-13 14:00 PT — Start staging soak (S2)
- 2026-10-14 15:30 PT — Post-soak review + signoff meeting (15m)
- 2026-10-14 16:00 PT — Pilot-region ramp to 2% (us-west-2)
- 2026-10-14 20:00 PT — Evaluate pilot metrics; escalate if any gate fails
- 2026-10-15 09:00 PT — EU ramp to 10%
- 2026-10-15 14:00 PT — APAC pilot (10%)
- 2026-10-16 09:00 PT — Full rollout begin -> expected complete by EOD
- 2026-10-18 09:00 PT — End of 48h elevated monitoring window

Post-deploy validation checklist (first 4 hours):
- [ ] Metrics steady: errors, latency, throughput within expected thresholds (owner: Liam)
- [ ] Sampling and manual spot-checks for generation quality (owner: Jenna + QE)
- [ ] Customer impacted alerts: none for priority customers (owner: customer-success contact list)
- [ ] Log volumes, S3 dump health, and tracing ingestion normal (owner: observability team)
- [ ] Cost dashboards sanity check vs forecast (owner: finance-infra liaison)

Release notes (draft) — short form to publish on Console updates & release email:
Title: Runtime v2.4.0 — routing policy and autoscale improvements
Highlights:
- Smarter regional routing to prefer lower-cost pools while maintaining latency SLOs.
- Autoscaling config schema extended: new fields allow per-model minimum availability and burst buckets.
- Performance improvements for KV cache warmup; average cold-start token latency reduced ~12% in staging.

Notes for operators:
- Config key name change: autoscale.min_available -> autoscale.min_instances (backwards compatible; old key still supported for two release cycles)
- If you run private deployments: upgrade package available at s3://redwood-releases/v2.4.0 (manual apply required).

Known issues (to call out):
- Small subset of dedicated pools may show transient rate-limit errors during regional ramp (working on mitigation: incremental handshake timeout bump).
- Private customers with custom routing hooks need to validate the hook version; see linked confluence page.

Post-release tasks (owners & due dates):
- 48h regression run of eval-set A and B -> owner: Jenna (due: 2026-10-19)
- Update SDK docs for autoscale key rename -> owner: DX (due: 2026-10-20)
- Customer communications: targeted emails for Dedicated customers + changelog entry -> owner: Radu (due: 2026-10-15 before full rollout)

Open questions / open todos (notes to triage in the post-FF meeting):
- Can we increase the pilot sample to 5% without affecting downstream billing pipelines? (Marco)
- Should we enable adaptive batching in the pilot or keep batching static until P2? (Liam)
- Verify telemetry retention window for the pilot is sufficient to catch transient latency spikes. (Aisha)

Quick links:
- Smoke run dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.com/dashboards/smoke-2026-10-13
- Rollout policy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4571
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/INF-2382-rollout-guidelines

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the pilot small and conservative — this routing change touches cost decisions and operator expectations.
- If anything ambiguous happens, default to pausing the ramp and leaning on the fallback routing policy.

Appendix: rapid checklist for on-call (single-sheet):
1) Check top-level SLOs -> if failing, flip routing.policy.fallback = true
2) If rollback needed: cut traffic to previous model + deploy rollback artifact (release/v2.3.9)
3) Notify #releases, escalate to Prod Eng and CS for high-impact customers

-- end of draft --

(Use this doc as the single source for operations during the Oct 12-16 rollout. Convert to final release notes and push to Console after P3 signoff.)
